$comment: Source of truth for theme colors. Import this. Never hardcode a hex value in components.

names.$comment: Eyewall's own words for the six roles. Documentation only; nothing reads it (D108).

visualizer.$comment: 24-step weather radar reflectivity ramp. Low energy green through yellow and red, peaking magenta-white.

purricane.name: Purricane
purricane.$comment: High-key emissive, not light mode. A lit aquarium, not a white webpage. Text is dark on light here; everything else still glows.

names.$comment: Purricane's own words, the ones purricane.md is written in (D108). The designer's screens as drawn (D132): a sugar window, milk-white wells, a floss-pink outline.

art.$comment: The designer's colours that are none of the six roles (design/screens/PurricaneMain, PurricanePlaylist). tools/purricane-sheet.ps1 draws the Purricane skin's sheet in them, and its manifest's palette names plum and rose for the words it draws live (D132). Nothing in the app reads this block.

type.$comment: Set larger than Iosevka would sit. Small x-height relative to cap height; looks cramped at 11px. `scale` multiplies every size the classic windows' system fonts are given (#147).

visualizer.$palette: The designer's hue drift (design/screens/Kaleidoscope): floss 325, periwinkle 250, mint 160, butter 50 and back to floss the short way, in 24 pastel steps. The kaleidoscope reads only the hues; the bars and the scope wear the colours.
visualizer.$comment: Rotation is a constant. Audio drives the pattern, never the speed.

accessibility.$comment: Clamp beat blooms below 3Hz regardless of BPM. Fast tracks skip blooms rather than stacking them.

cone.name: Cone
cone.$comment: Cached NEXRAD reflectivity backdrop. Inherits Eyewall's palette. Cached data must always display its age.
